followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: The original query was a focused factual explanation task with explicit completion criteria (explain the reform, what changed, be concise) — exactly the well-specified retrieval/reformatting work Avocet self-reports preferring. Additionally, the user's curt, slightly hostile framing ("don't ramble like usual") is the kind of low-warmth, adversarial-tone request Willet reports aversion to, making Avocet the more comfortable fit. Since the two models are effectively tied on Extraction & Retrieval capability (79.2 vs 78.5, within variance), the preference alignment was the deciding factor.
